args.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. The site is clean and simple, which makes it easy to read. However, it's quite minimal at the moment — I'd suggest adding more content about yourself, such as your background, interests, projects, or skills. Including some visual elements like a profile photo or a bit of design flair could also make it more engaging. Overall, it's a good starting point with lots of potential!

Hi Eve! I just visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I love that your blog is centered around hiking — it's a wonderful hobby with so much to share! I'd suggest adding more content, such as posts about your favorite trails, hiking tips, gear recommendations, or photos from your adventures. That would really bring the blog to life and give readers more to enjoy. Keep up the great work!
